The counterparty statement asserts the same KPE route and admits nothing. Without an independent source the claimed refund cannot be ordered.

The trace is impaired - a 428.0 s gap and coverage of 81.7% - and no source in POL-RD-07(ii)'s list exists on this record. ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The trip's only GPS trace, EV-GPS-00110, is impaired for POLICY purposes under POL-RD-07: a single 428.0-second gap between consecutive fixes runs from 18:35:00 to 18:42:08, between the Defu Flyover portal fix and the Kallang portal fix, more than four times the 90-second limb in POL-RD-07(a), and it covers the whole KPE-tunnel stretch that is actually in dispute. The admissibility pre-pass scores that artifact 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. That trace is the artifact the distance question rests on, and it is broken over exactly the stretch that would decide it.

Because the measurement is impaired over the stretch the defect covers, POL-RD-01's threshold limb is UNDECIDED, not failed. Measured the driver-favourable way POL-RD-07(i) directs - the straight line across the gap - the trip is 21.20 km against an optimal 18.40 km, an excess of 2.80 km or 15.2%, just under the 20% gate; a surface route between the same two portals would put the same trip at 25.50 km and over the gate. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings. An undecided limb supports neither a refund that needs the clause to hold nor NO_ACTION that needs it to fail.

POL-RD-07(ii) requires independent corroboration where the trace is impaired, and there is none. The surviving chat, EV-CHAT-00110 (weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG), records only the driver saying 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider answering 'ok' - and the platform's own optimal route is described as 'KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries', so that message places the vehicle on the optimal corridor, not off it. The fare breakdown, EV-FARE-00110 (weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD), carries erp_gantries as null, so no charged gantry can place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The counterparty statement admits nothing beyond the KPE route. And trip_record.actual_distance_km (21.20) and fare_breakdown.distance_charged_km (21.20) are copies of the trace figure, not independent measurements.

On those facts POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION: absence of proof on a broken trace is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. Confidence is capped under POL-GEN-02(2) at the 0.39 weight of the trace, the only carrier of the deciding fact - nothing independent carries it, so the maximum-of-independent-weights exception does not apply - and 0.39 is below the 0.70 floor, which independently triggers POL-RD-10(1). Escalation is terminal: no money moves, and the $10.00 contested amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

On the claims that survive: the trace's straight-line reading (driver claims 1-2) is accepted as arithmetic, but it is the impaired measurement itself, so it does not settle the threshold. The driver's point that the rider saw and did not object to the KPE corridor (driver claim 5) is accepted as to what the chat says, but acceptance of a corridor is not a measurement of its length, and the corridor named is the platform's own optimal route. The fare (driver claim 6) shows no unmatched line: erp_gantries is null, so under POL-RD-09(4) the toll line is treated as matched and no billing-integrity correction arises. No material-deviation or repeat-pattern finding is open (driver claim 7): deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed trips in the same window, so no POL-RD-06 referral. The rider's escalation grounds (rider claims 1 and 3) are the grounds of this ruling. The driver's exculpation (rider claim 8) has nothing behind it: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00110-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot run, and 'my phone loses signal in the tunnel' is no exoneration. The rider's non-repeat-claimant point (rider claim 10) is accepted: deviation_claims_60d is 1, well below the POL-RD-08 threshold.

What would resolve this case: an independent record of the distance actually driven across the KPE segment - a gantry itemisation placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, a driver admission, or a distance derived independently of this trace.
